title: BFS animation 3 cues
prerequisite: Learner knows graph nodes and directed edges from A to B and A to C.
success_check: Learner recites visit order A then B then C and predicts the queue before each visit, then compares.

scenes.title: BFS visit order A B C
scenes.concept_target: Breadth-first search visits nodes A, then B, then C in queue order while node positions stay fixed.

narration_cues.text: Cue v03a. Breadth-first search starts at node A. Visit A first. The queue now holds B and C.
narration_cues.change: Graph appears at fixed positions and node A turns visited; queue shows B and C.

narration_cues.text: Cue v03b. Next, take node B from the queue and visit it. The queue now holds C.
narration_cues.change: Node B turns visited; queue readout updates to C only.

narration_cues.text: Cue v03c. Finally, take node C from the queue and visit it. The queue is empty. Visit order is A, then B, then C.
narration_cues.change: Node C turns visited and the final order caption stays readable with an empty queue.
